audit_scope: Active compact main/supplement scientific claims, their preserved result summaries and the maintained assumption/transport helpers. No training, protected target scoring or historical-authority rewriting.
scope_statement: This register audits explicit premises and evidentiary support. It is not proof of distributional assumptions for every real setting and not a fresh rerun of all experiments.

status_vocabulary.conditional_only: Mathematical claim follows only when the named premise holds.
status_vocabulary.unestablished_for_deployment: No general empirical or design authority establishes this premise for intended future deployments.
status_vocabulary.study_specific_only: Inspectable design/measurement facts support the bounded study; distributional validity is separate.
status_vocabulary.unestablished_for_historical_panels: Current historical records do not supply this premise.
status_vocabulary.qualified_not_end_to_end: Numerical subclaim is bounded and separate from exact statistical validity.
status_vocabulary.descriptive_only: Recorded results or sensitivity support description, not a population guarantee.
status_vocabulary.implemented_guard: Software enforces a limited check; it does not establish scientific assumptions.

assumptions.requirement: The exact disagreement identity uses binary 0/1 loss, measurable fixed predictors and d=P(D)>0.
assumptions.what_is_established: On binary disagreement exactly one prediction is correct; d=0 gives zero benefit and requires no conditional margin.
assumptions.what_is_not_established: The identical identity for unrestricted multiclass tasks or other losses.
assumptions.verification_route: Check theorem domain and metric before use; retain the paired multiclass construction as a separate theorem.

assumptions.requirement: Necessity/attainability quantify the full class of allowed disagreement-region label kernels.
assumptions.what_is_established: Compatible-kernel construction in the active population proof.
assumptions.what_is_not_established: Real benchmark populations are not shown to equal this rich class; narrower classes may identify more.
assumptions.verification_route: Retain full-class quantifiers for necessity; sufficiency may carry to a subclass satisfying the same bound.

assumptions.requirement: The target residual obeys the externally supplied absolute bound beta.
assumptions.what_is_established: Conditional frontier and evidence-fibre audit obstruction state what follows from a declared bound.
assumptions.what_is_not_established: A nontrivial universal beta learned from the same label-free observations; empirical epsilon is not beta.
assumptions.verification_route: Require external domain knowledge, target-label evidence with valid sampling, or an explicit transfer restriction; otherwise no strict population claim.

assumptions.requirement: Evidence-law fibres exclude opposite population signs when invoking sign identifiability.
assumptions.what_is_established: Population definition distinguishes sign identification from predictive calibration.
assumptions.what_is_not_established: Label-free diagnostics do not verify risk alignment; alignment alone does not supply interval coverage or rule out a zero-versus-positive fibre.
assumptions.verification_route: State the fibre restriction explicitly; do not substitute an observed support-overlap score.

assumptions.requirement: The interval covers its declared scalar benefit and unit marginally with probability at least 1-alpha.
assumptions.what_is_established: Coverage-to-action event containment; both wrong-direction events are contained in a coverage miss.
assumptions.what_is_not_established: Observed hit rates, a coverage-basis metadata record or passing validators cannot establish the premise on an arbitrary target distribution.
assumptions.verification_route: Support via a theorem with matching sampling design, or report descriptive inclusion only; abstain as an operational fallback when unsupported.

assumptions.requirement: Calibration and next-unit scores are jointly exchangeable under the same fitting and candidate-construction rule.
assumptions.what_is_established: Exact-rank algebra, no clipping, and disjoint computational roles are checkable.
assumptions.what_is_not_established: Disjoint rows or folds do not imply exchangeability across corruption families, checkpoints or geography. Poor held-out inclusion challenges the particular transfer use, not every possible exchangeability model.
assumptions.verification_route: Declare the sampling population and score construction; independent development fitting plus exchangeable calibration/new units is sufficient. Record finite-rank ineligibility separately.

assumptions.requirement: Sampling, calibration aggregation and uncertainty units match the population claim.
assumptions.what_is_established: Recorded cell, corruption-family, checkpoint, camera-location and city denominators are distinct. The helper counts declared groups and validates label count.
assumptions.what_is_not_established: Unique labels do not prove independence. Multiple checkpoints in one city or cells in one corruption do not create independent environments.
assumptions.verification_route: Bind group membership and aggregation before analysis; group-max score for simultaneous within-unit coverage requires exchangeable complete units.

assumptions.requirement: For sampling concentration, predictor pair and score are fixed independently of fresh evidence/evaluation observations, conditional on allowed development randomness.
assumptions.what_is_established: Fresh-draw conditions are explicit in the population bridge and transport construction.
assumptions.what_is_not_established: Transductive candidate updates and evaluation-batch normalization do not meet independent fresh-sample assumptions merely because labels are hidden.
assumptions.verification_route: Use separate adaptation and evaluation samples or prove a valid dependence-aware replacement; do not reinterpret historical m=2000 as an independent-sample count.

assumptions.requirement: Evaluation outcomes do not tune candidate, predictor, radius, thresholds or stopping before scoring.
assumptions.what_is_established: Outcome-exclusion perturbation tests support the inspected saved-feature computation; receipts preserve execution chronology for scoped runs.
assumptions.what_is_not_established: Metadata hashes do not establish universal historical nonaccess or absent upstream leakage. CCT candidate ranking used label metadata.
assumptions.verification_route: Bind executable protocol before the eligible data role opens, archive decisions before scoring, and state exactly which level of access was excluded.

assumptions.requirement: Peer-dependent LOO residuals need a valid LOO theorem or an independently justified stability argument, not split-conformal rank algebra alone.
assumptions.what_is_established: The maintained text discloses indirect dependence in Protocol A; B6 additionally clips an unavailable rank.
assumptions.what_is_not_established: A uniform estimator stability bound for historical LOO panels; an exact nominal-90% B6 guarantee.
assumptions.verification_route: Retain LOO/B6 as descriptive; for a new study use a genuinely disjoint calibration design or prove the appropriate estimator theorem.

assumptions.requirement: Paired transport requires the externally declared target-prior-weighted conditional-TV budget rho.
assumptions.what_is_established: Conditional feasible-set argument and explicit same-evidence violated-budget diagnostic.
assumptions.what_is_not_established: Unlabeled source/target prediction counts alone cannot identify the missing transport restriction.
assumptions.verification_route: Justify rho externally and report sensitivity; remain conditional when such justification is unavailable.

assumptions.requirement: Probability boxes and conditional-risk bounds need the appropriate binomial sampling law; risk trials require common conditional error probability as well as independence.
assumptions.what_is_established: Source-class stratification and target marginal counts receive simultaneous Bonferroni binomial boxes. Zero-count bins/classes are retained.
assumptions.what_is_not_established: Independence alone is insufficient for heterogeneous Bernoulli group errors to use an ordinary binomial bound; current historical groups are not established iid trials.
assumptions.verification_route: Bind the source-class sampling design, target sampling law and fixed threshold family; no target-label selection. Treat current conditional-risk rows as descriptive.

assumptions.requirement: Numerical probability bounds and LP bounds must enclose the exact quantities they claim to certify.
assumptions.what_is_established: Directed weak-dual arithmetic bounds the exact binary64 LP objective for every feasible point of the supplied problem.
assumptions.what_is_not_established: One-ULP expansion of scipy inverse-beta quantiles is not a certified exact Clopper-Pearson implementation; residual checks do not prove exact primal feasibility/nonemptiness.
assumptions.verification_route: Retain this boundary unless validated quantile enclosures and exact feasibility witnesses are implemented and checked. Statistical theorem and implementation certificate remain separate.

assumptions.requirement: Marginal coverage must not be promoted to error conditional on ADAPT, a selected environment, or passing a data-dependent screen.
assumptions.what_is_established: FA_u and FA_c use distinct denominators; zero ADAPT leaves FA_c undefined. So2Sat screen has no selection-conditional theorem.
assumptions.what_is_not_established: Pr(B<=0|ADAPT)<=alpha from a marginal interval guarantee; a valid screened-target guarantee.
assumptions.verification_route: Use a separately valid selection-conditional construction if required; otherwise state unconditional scope and report accepted exposure.

assumptions.requirement: Multiple candidates, repeated decisions and adaptive stopping need an explicit joint/time-uniform error construction.
assumptions.what_is_established: The active single-decision statements explicitly exclude automatic repeated-use control.
assumptions.what_is_not_established: Per-decision alpha does not imply family-wise alpha, anytime alpha or adaptive-reuse validity.
assumptions.verification_route: A prespecified finite family can allocate budgets with a union bound only when each premise remains valid under the actual selection process; adaptive reuse needs a suitable conditional/time-uniform theorem.

assumptions.requirement: Bootstrap uncertainty requires a sampling model at the declared cluster level and sufficient support for the intended inference.
assumptions.what_is_established: Paired resampling preserves observed within-cluster relationships; low-N sensitivity and leave-one-cluster-out results are recorded.
assumptions.what_is_not_established: Six CIFAR families or three ImageNet/checkpoint clusters do not establish reliable population-level coverage. A positive endpoint is not itself evidence of valid coverage.
assumptions.verification_route: Keep nominal/descriptive labels; collect genuinely independent environments for a predeclared inferential claim.

assumptions.requirement: Sign-flip reference validity requires joint coordinatewise sign invariance under the null.
assumptions.what_is_established: Enumeration exactly computes the stated reference statistic; independent zero-symmetric cluster gaps suffice.
assumptions.what_is_not_established: Exchangeability, marginal symmetry or only a global sign symmetry is insufficient; all-positive observed gaps do not verify the null model.
assumptions.verification_route: State the reference model; retain p-values as conditional reference values unless the sampling/randomization design supports it.

assumptions.requirement: Multiplicity correction requires valid constituent tests/intervals and does not undo exploratory selection.
assumptions.what_is_established: Declared families and retrospective analysis choices are distinguished in the source.
assumptions.what_is_not_established: Holm over selected rows cannot turn a posthoc panel into a prospectively confirmatory family or fix invalid marginal tests.
assumptions.verification_route: Prespecify every primary comparison and retain failures for a new confirmatory design; report current sensitivity as exploratory.

assumptions.requirement: The benefit target, class universe, aggregation and loss definition must match the claimed theorem and comparison.
assumptions.what_is_established: Accuracy regret, weighted 100L5, interval inclusion and macro-F1 are separated; invalid iWildCam metrics remain withheld.
assumptions.what_is_not_established: Macro-F1 does not inherit the bounded per-image accuracy Hoeffding bridge; universal accuracy/F1 improvement is not established.
assumptions.verification_route: Recompute from the declared metric contract and pair exactly aligned records; preserve null/undefined values and absent-class conventions.

assumptions.requirement: A diagnostic can withhold action when it detects a warning but cannot establish an unobserved coverage premise or benefit sign.
assumptions.what_is_established: The corrected legacy API returns unresolved/abstain for no-warning inputs; current coverage-basis validation explicitly reports syntax-only scope.
assumptions.what_is_not_established: The frozen legacy v1 applies/ADAPT fields and old gate reports do not establish statistical assumptions.
assumptions.verification_route: Use the new correction record; leave original bytes intact and never promote not_falsified to verified.

findings.description: No-warning label-free evidence incorrectly emitted guarantee applies and ADAPT.
findings.remediation: Return unresolved and abstain; absent residual drift is null; reject malformed inputs. Preserve original v1 authorities and issue separately bound posthoc correction.

findings.description: Invalid alpha and residual shapes/nonfinite values could produce a misleading rank; mismatched group length could inflate declared-unit count; empty residuals crashed gate formatting.
findings.remediation: Validate alpha and finite vector shape, align group labels with rows, keep empty radius infinite and gate diagnostic; count is explicitly not independence proof.

findings.description: CoverageClaimBasis.validate checks syntax and record unit consistency, not source bytes or statistical assumption truth.
findings.remediation: Serialize validation_scope, artifact_bytes_authenticated=false, distributional_assumptions_established=false. A recorded theoretical claim remains conditional.

findings.description: Inactive A7 prose omits the LOO coverage-event premise in its contrapositive. Old report seed heterogeneity is described as proof of nonexchangeability; these snapshots are not active main-panel authorities.
findings.remediation: Do not cite them as current theorem or assumption validation; use active source and this scoped register. Preserved bytes are historical evidence, not endorsed claims.

findings.description: No computational audit can establish every target exchangeability law, external beta/rho, future transfer or complete missing historical execution.
findings.remediation: Require specific external arguments/new eligible design before strengthening claims; preserve conditional or descriptive status.
